title: incident-context-timestamp-normalizer-and-noise-filter
author: Maya Hsu
description: Motivation: Runbook suggestion quality is degraded when incident context contains inconsistent timestamps (multiple timezones, clock skew) and noisy ephemeral artifacts (k8s restart events, synthetic health-check logs). This PR implements a lightweight timestamp normalizer and a configurable noise filter that runs in the incident context enrichment pipeline before runbook scoring. The goal is to reduce duplicate suggestion churn, prioritize durable signals (errors/exceptions, stack traces, metric anomalies), and make temporal reasoning in templates (e.g., "service flapped 3 times in 10m") deterministic across on-call regions. What this changes: 1) timestamp-normalizer: heuristics to parse and canonicalize timestamps from logs, span events, and alert bodies; handles ISO, RFC, unix, and common human formats; detects and corrects obvious clock skew using event clusters; attaches normalized_iso_ts metadata to context entries. 2) noise-filter: rule-based filter with whitelist/blacklist patterns and probabilistic deduping for frequent ephemeral messages (kubelet restart, readiness probe failures, autoscaler probe logs). 3) scoring tweak: runbook-suggester now weights normalized timestamps and durable-event markers higher when building incident timelines. 4) telemetry: new metrics incidentbot.context.normalized_count, incidentbot.context.noise_filtered_count, and a histogram for normalized time-delta distribution to monitor skew corrections. 5) migrations: adds a lightweight data-format bump for context cache entries (v2) and safe fallback to v1. Backwards compatibility: v1 cached contexts are still accepted; normalizer runs at enrichment time and writes v2 cache on first update. Testing: unit tests for parsers, e2e integration test that runs sample incidents with multi-timezone logs and asserts stable runbook ranking, and a simulated noise replay test to validate dedupe thresholds. Checklist: - [x] timestamp parser unit tests - [x] noise filter rule engine tests - [x] integration test with runbook ranking - [x] telemetry and dashboard patch - [x] update to context cache versioning - [x] docs: added developer doc for normalizer heuristics (docs/dev/incident-normalizer.md) Rollout plan: start with feature-flag enabled only for 10% of production incidents, monitor incidentbot.context.noise_filtered_rate and runbook divergence metric for two weeks, then ramp. Related: ENG-4829 implements UI hooks for visible normalized timestamps in the oncall timeline. This description includes all rationale, design choices, and risks in one continuous block for easy consumption in code review.
commits: 3 commits: (1) 8f2a1c9 - add timestamp normalizer module, parsers and tests; (2) d4b3f55 - implement noise-filter engine, rules, and integration; (3) 3be9d2a - telemetry, cache version bump, docs and migration path. High-level commit summary included unit and integration tests and a migration hook to avoid invalidating existing cached contexts.
review_conversation:
Lena Ortiz (reviewer) 2025-11-15: Looks good overall, but the clock skew correction logic could be risky for systems with purposely skewed clocks (embedded devices). Can we add a per-source override flag?
Maya Hsu (author) 2025-11-15: Good catch — added a per-source 'allow_skew_correction' flag with default 'true' and documented it; updated tests to cover disabled-skew case.
Samir Patel (reviewer) 2025-11-16: A couple of nit comments: prefer explicit timezone handling for RFC formats and please add a small flame test for the dedupe threshold under high-frequency noise.
Maya Hsu (author) 2025-11-17: Addressed both: RFC parser now enforces tz-aware datetimes; added synthetic load test (tests/integration/test_noise_replay.py) and a flag 'noise_dedupe_window_ms' for safe tuning.
Gregory Miles (approver) 2025-11-19: Approving after verifying telemetry and cache migration behaviour on staging. Observability team ran staging replay and saw normalized_count increment and no runbook regressions.
CI Bot 2025-11-20: All checks passed (unit, lint, integration). Merge queue OK.
release_notes: Added incident context timestamp normalization and noise filtering to improve runbook suggestion stability. Feature behind feature-flag and rolling 10% rollout; telemetry added for monitoring. Backwards compatible with context cache v1.
